planet.name: Hunt The THING
planet.summary: An arctic movie tie-in area for 'The Thing' (2011), reached from ROCKtropia's teleporter drop-down. MindArk staff said in February 2025 that NEVERDIE had decided to deactivate the instance. No sign of it returning was found up to November 2026.
planet.howToReach: Not reachable. It used to be a separate area chosen from the drop-down at any ROCKtropia teleporter.
warnings: Inactive since early 2025, per a MindArk staff post on the official forum (2025-02-07).
Some community guides (joinentropia.com, Entropia Nexus maps, rocktropia.com's 'Featuring THE THING') still list Hunt The THING missions or maps. That content is stale.
THING creatures still exist on the ROCKtropia mainland, and a 2022 blog mentions a 'Hunt Things' mission on Secret Island. These are not the old instance.

sources.title: Bring Hunt The Thing Back
sources.publisher: Entropia Universe Forum (includes MindArk staff reply by Ludvig_MindArk)
sources.supports: Players note HTT is gone (2025-01-31). The MindArk reply (2025-02-07) says NeverDie decided to deactivate it and items can be recovered through a support case.

sources.title: Mindark takes over the operations of Planet Rocktropia to be Run by New Entropia Universe AI President
sources.supports: Hunt The Thing was a movie-tie-in destination made through a Universal licensing partnership.

sources.title: RockTropia - Mission Guide & Knowledge Base
sources.supports: Still lists HTT access point and Sgt Savagery missions (stale).

activities.title: Items left in Hunt The THING: open a support case
activities.summary: If you had items stored or left in the Hunt The THING area when it was shut down, MindArk said they are not lost. Open a support case and support will move them somewhere you can reach.
steps: Open a support case with MindArk.
Say which items were left in Hunt The THING and ask for them to be moved.
requirementsText: You had items in the old HTT area
activities.limits: Only for players with items there.

score.rationale: Only matters to returning players with stranded items.
